'''''Loranda''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Hetton]], named after his mother, [[Loranda]]. The ship was eighty meters in length and could hold up to twenty passengers. Only one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was required to fly the ship. With Hetton's modifications, the ship had enough [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Laser/Legends|firepower]] to tackle a small [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. Its interior was described as luxurious.
